Keep it under 2 MB — everything is stored on this device, and large attachments fill up storage quickly. A phone photo of the invoice works fine; try to avoid multi-page scanned PDFs.

📥 Bulk Import Items from Excel / CSV

Add many items to this purchase at once instead of searching for each one — shaped to match a real supplier "Credit Sale" invoice (Particulars, Qty, Rate, Discount%), so you can transcribe a paper/PDF invoice straight into the template. Download it, fill it in (Excel, Google Sheets, or Numbers), then upload — .xlsx and .csv both work directly, no need to convert. Rows are matched to your catalog by SKU if given, otherwise by an exact Particulars name match. A row that matches nothing existing creates a new product automatically (with an auto-generated SKU and default pricing) rather than being skipped — since that's usually how a genuinely new part first enters the catalog. An optional Gift column takes a "buy+free" scheme like 9+1 or 14+1 — free bonus units get added to stock automatically when the purchase is saved.

📲 WhatsApp Settings

Used when sending a digital receipt — customer numbers saved without a country code (e.g. starting with 0) are completed using this.

🗂️ Backup & Restore

All your data is stored only on this device's browser storage — there is no automatic cloud sync. Export a backup regularly (e.g. daily) and keep the file somewhere safe (email it to yourself, save to USB/Google Drive/etc). If your phone or laptop is lost, damaged, or the browser data is cleared, unbacked-up data cannot be recovered.

🔒 Backup, restore, and erase are restricted to Admin accounts — a backup file contains everything, including employee login PINs, and restoring/erasing replaces all data on this device.

The .html backup is a complete, self-contained working copy of the app with today's data already loaded in — open it directly (double-click, or drag into a browser) and it works immediately, no import step needed. The .json backup is smaller and is what "Import Backup" above expects.

⏱️ Auto-Backup

Automatically downloads a backup once the interval below has passed — but only while this app is actually open in a browser tab; it can't run in the background or while the device is off/closed. Your browser may ask for a "multiple downloads" permission the first time.

Last auto-backup: 04/08/2026, 01:53 AM

📊 Storage Usage

Two separate limits matter here: this browser's own local storage (roughly 5-10MB, varies by browser, holds everything on this device) and — if this is open as a shared Claude Artifact — a 5MB ceiling per shared data bundle below. Getting close to either doesn't crash the app by itself; it just means the next save may fail to reach the cloud (it still saves on this device either way) until something's freed up.

Transactions (sales, returns, stock movements, purchases, demands, held sales) 772.2 KB / 5 MB (15%)
Catalog & contacts (products, customers, suppliers, employees, customer payments, settings) 333.8 KB / 5 MB (7%)
Accounting (expenses, capital, drawings, distributions, liabilities, fixed assets, chart of accounts, journal, bank feed) 2.6 KB / 5 MB (0%)
Total local storage on this device: 1.03 MB (browsers typically allow roughly 5-10MB per site here, varies by browser).

📲 Install as an App

If this page is hosted online (not opened as a local file), you can install it to your phone or laptop home screen for a full offline app experience. Look for the "Install" button in the header, or use your browser's "Add to Home Screen" / "Install App" menu option.

💰 Profit & Loss Statement

Pick a date range to generate a proper P&L: Revenue → Cost of Goods Sold → Gross Profit → Operating Expenses (by category) → Net Profit.

📊 Balance Sheet (as of today)

Built from real sales, purchases, inventory, registered fixed assets, and recorded liabilities. Cash on Hand defaults to your most recent saved cash reconciliation; adjust it if today's count is different.

🧮 Partner Equity Breakdown

How total owner's equity above is split across partners, based on capital contributed, drawings taken, and distributed-but-unwithdrawn profit.

🤝 Partners

Ownership shares are used to split distributed profit. Shares must add up to 100%.

💼 Capital Contributions

Record money or assets a partner has put into the business.

💵 Distribute Profit

Available profit is calculated as all-time Net Profit (from the P&L) minus profit already distributed.

Distributed profit sits here until a partner withdraws it as cash (drawings) or reinvests it as capital.

🏧 Record a Drawing

Cash or assets a partner has taken out of the business for personal use — separate from a salary/wage.

📊 Drawings by Partner

📜 Drawings History

🏦 Other Liabilities

Bank loans, partner loans, taxes payable — anything owed beyond ordinary supplier invoices (those are tracked automatically under Purchases).

🏗️ Fixed Assets

Equipment, vehicles, furniture — non-inventory assets owned by the business, tracked at cost.

💧 Cash Flow Statement

Cash actually collected and paid out in a date range, grouped as Operating, Investing, and Financing — reuses the same From/To range as the P&L tab.

📚 Chart of Accounts

The list of accounts Journal Entries post to. Seeded with a standard set — add, rename, or deactivate as your books need.

➕ Add Account

📝 New Journal Entry

Every entry must balance — total debits must equal total credits before it can be saved.

Debits: Rs. 0  |  Credits: Rs. 0  |  Difference: Rs. 0

📜 Journal History

📖 General Ledger

Every posting to one account, in order, with a running balance.

⚖️ Trial Balance

Every account's balance as of today. Total debits and total credits must match — that's what makes it a trial balance.

🏛️ Bank Feed

Bring in your bank statement, then categorize each line against a Chart of Accounts entry — that's all it takes. Categorizing immediately posts a balanced Journal Entry against your Bank Account, so it flows straight into the General Ledger and Trial Balance, and into the Profit & Loss if it's Revenue or Expense. Clearing a category removes that entry again.

📥 Upload Bank Statement (.csv)

Three columns, in this order: Date, Description, Amount (negative for withdrawals). A 4th optional column, Category, can match an account name or code from your Chart of Accounts to categorize rows automatically as they're imported. Most banks' exports can be rearranged into this in Excel in a minute or two.

This downloads the receipt as a real PDF (with the shop logo) to your device, then opens WhatsApp with a message ready — you'll need to attach that downloaded PDF yourself using WhatsApp's 📎 icon and tap Send. A few things are outside this app's control: your phone/browser may ask whether to open the link in the WhatsApp app or your browser (that prompt comes from your device, not this app), and there's no free way to attach or send the file fully automatically without a paid WhatsApp Business API. Opening WhatsApp from here always reuses the same browser tab rather than piling up new ones.
